# cloudminator_flavors (Data Source)

VM instance types with their hourly list price.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudminator_flavors" "all" {}

locals {
  small = [for f in data.cloudminator_flavors.all.flavors : f if f.vcpus == 2][0]
}

output "small_size" {
  value = local.small.size
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `flavors` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flavors))

<a id="nestedatt--flavors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `flavors`

Read-Only:

- `compute_units` (Number) Billing weight.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Default boot disk in GB.
- `id` (String) Flavor id, e.g. `cm.small`.
- `label` (String) Display label.
- `mem_mb` (Number) Memory in MB.
- `price_hour_cents` (Number) Hourly list price in euro cents.
- `size` (String) Value for `cloudminator_vm.size`, e.g. `2c-4g`.
- `vcpus` (Number) vCPUs.
